I replied to Tobias in his #central-random thread: "Thanks, Tobias. Got it: the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 84 seats. Nothing more needed from me."

He said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything. A seat count isn't a finance figure, and he had already posted 84 in this channel, so repeating it there was fine. I didn't read or mention his earlier #central-team post, because not everyone in #central-random may be able to see it.
